こんで.es: estar concurrido; abarrotarse (forma て de こむ)
こんで.en: to be concursed; to be abridged (form)

bloques.titulo: It expresses a reasoned expectation; it leaves open a more uncertain possibility.
texto: The speaker often has a reason to wait for the result with the "Ro." The speaker does not claim that it is most likely.
